Title: Admin UI cannot upload a lender logo, so no lender can be added from the UI
Where (endpoint / screen): UI /lenders?create=1 -> browser PUT to gus-dev-bucket S3 presigned URL
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open Lenders > Add lender. 2. Choose any PNG as logo. 3. Fill all required fields. 4. Click Create lender.
Actual: CORS policy initially blocked S3 direct preflight. FIXED: Logo upload now proxies through app endpoint. UI end-to-end verified: presign 200, upload 200, lender create 201, logo stored. Retested and passing 2026-10-26.
Suggested fix: S3 bucket CORS: allow PUT/OPTIONS from admin origin(s).

Title: Add product form silently drops invalid eligibility criteria and still submits
Steps to reproduce: 1. Fill the form validly. 2. Set Minimum age = -1, 18.5, max age 200, DTI 'abc', surplus -1, income -1. 3. Click Create product. 4. Inspect request.
Expected: Field error shown, nothing submitted (API rejects these values with 422).
Actual: VERIFIED FIXED 2026-10-26: Client-side validation now catches and displays field-level errors for all invalid criteria values (negative age, decimal age, string DTI, negative income, negative surplus). Form submission is blocked and no write is sent. Verified by LP-032 (6 cases all passing).
Suggested fix: Product form criteria parsing: treat a non-empty value that fails parsing as a validation error.

Title: API accepts creating and editing a product under a deactivated lender
Steps to reproduce: 1. Use a lender with isActive=false. 2. POST /products with that lenderId. 3. PUT existing product with {"lenderId": inactive}.
Actual: FIXED: Create and move both return 409 LENDER_INACTIVE 'That lender is deactivated and cannot take new products'. Retested and verified.
Suggested fix: Product create/update service: check lender.isActive next to existing lender-exists check.

Title: Writes limited to 100/hour and rejected requests count against the limit

Actual: 429 RATE_LIMITED, retry-after up to 3600s, blocks mutations; reads unaffected. Architecture decision pending.
Suggested fix: Admin API rate-limit middleware: count only successful mutations or raise ceiling.
